issues.description: The 'Judge re-test' section and the 'Wrong, weak or not tested' list say 59 of the 77 test items are one question type. The correct figure is 58: loop.beats_baseline is 58 of 77 in data/retest/results.json by_kind (58+10+8+1) and in items.jsonl.

The review says 71 loop.idea_worth_run verdicts exist in the run directories (stated twice, in the weaknesses and the open items). Recounting runs/*/gates.jsonl gives 84 loop.idea_worth_run records: 75 in current-wording runs and 9 in older-wording runs. All 75 current ones are in the 77 'no programmatic answer' exclusions (the other 2 are best_method ties). 71 is the count of distinct real items, so the figure is conflated.

The re-test is judged only against T1's 95% reverse-if. Requirement JDG-P-01 in docs/02 sets the decided path at >=97% agreement with the reference. The point estimate is 97.4%, but the Wilson lower bound is 91.0%, and the review never compares the result with JDG-P-01. It states only the lower bound against 95%.

The 5 h overhead entry is described as 'one retrospective figure for the whole increment'. It was recorded at 2026-10-02T10:42:56Z, before loop-001 started (ledger 11:03Z). It was also before loop_run (11:58Z) and judge_retest (12:33Z), two of the three gates that passed that day. It cannot cover them, and its note is just 'hours'. check_dogfood.py passes because an entry exists on that UTC day, so the pass rests on a figure that predates most of the day's work. The review explains the 10-01 technicality but not this one.

The dogfood section says '4 Evaluator verdicts from Increment 1'. Telemetry holds 4 evaluator_verdict events: 2 for incr0_review (2026-09-30) and 2 for incr1_review (2026-10-01). None are from Increment 2.

'No run in this increment (17 runs counting loop-001) did' and 'No run of the 17' undercount. The increment also has smoke-001..007, of which smoke-004, 006 and 007 ran ideas (none beat both datasets), and the five invalidated standby runs. The 17 is the 16 comparison runs plus loop-001. The conclusion holds but the denominator is wrong or unexplained.

issues.description: The T7 table says 'three runs per arm', but its token sums include the five discarded standby runs (-1). For GLM, ledger sums of p3.* tokens are 13,017/12,935 with run -1 and 10,326/10,312 for runs 2-4. Sonnet is 15,465/17,324 against 10,317/12,604. The shares (15-23%, 1-4%) are probably close to unchanged, but the review repeats them without noticing.

docs/07 marks Increment 2 'complete 2026-10-02' and Increment 3 '← CURRENT'. CONTRACT.md says 'Increments 0, 1 and 2 are complete... Only Increment 3 work is in scope'. gate-state.json shows incr2_review has not passed. The documents assert the gate outcome before the gate and before this Evaluator round.

'Finished fastest' for Sonnet holds only on mean wall time (about 591 s against GLM about 694 s). gen-glm-3 took 530 s, faster than any Sonnet run (541-682 s). gen-glm-4 stopped early on the audit. The caveat is not stated.

The generator-comparison table omits the live completion counts in generator_comparison.json: completed 2/3 for A, 2/3 for B, 1/3 for D, 0/3 for MiMo, 3/3 for Sonnet. gen-glm-4 stopped live on a red audit, and only gen-glm-sonnet-2's live stop is discussed. The review also says 'Of the runs I checked', so the stop-reason review is partial.
The 'Independent Evaluator' section lists no round and no findings; it is a template only. SPEC requires every verdict to be kept and the findings listed.

The ECTS-HFD comparison says the author looked at the inventory row only after the run, but the row has been in data/corpus_inventory.csv since Increment 0 and is self-reported. Nothing is wrong, but 'no peeking' rests on the loop's spec not containing it, not on the repo.

notes: GAPS: 1) 58 vs 59 beats_baseline items. 2) idea_worth_run count 71 should be 84 (75 current, 9 old). 3) JDG-P-01 (>=97%) not compared with the re-test CI. 4) The 5 h dogfood entry predates the loop run and re-test, so 'whole increment' is wrong, and check_dogfood passes on a weak basis. 5) '4 Evaluator verdicts from Increment 1' should be 2 from Incr 0 and 2 from Incr 1. 6) '17 runs' omits smoke and standby runs. 7) docs/04 T7 table sums include standby runs despite 'three runs per arm'. 8) docs/07 and CONTRACT.md declare Increment 2 complete and Increment 3 current before incr2_review passes. 9) 'Fastest' is a mean-only claim. 10) The Evaluator-rounds section is empty. 11) The review never says whether any hit in the 22 audit claims was independently checked, but item 13 of the deviations covers this. The baseline target changes and dates match, and the 4 of 11 judge-call note matches the first-runs file. Telemetry shows 6 gates passed on 10-01 and 3 on 10-02, plus one gate_blocked event for trades_decided_2 at 23:51Z that the dogfood report does not count. check_dogfood.py behaves as the review describes. pytest 367 passed, ruff clean, traceability OK (17 requirements).
